provinces.name: Glacial Everwood
provinces.description: A bitter cold, snow-blanketed expanse of pine forests and rugged frozen steppes.

provinces.name: Ironhold Highlands
provinces.description: An aggressive terrain of volcanic fissures, rich iron deposits, and rocky high passes.

provinces.name: Golden Sunplains
provinces.description: A vast expanse of golden wheat grasslands, sun-kissed plains, and commercial trade routes.

provinces.name: Verdant Wilds
provinces.description: A dense, wet swamp and thick forest basin teeming with ancient beasts and overgrown ruins.

provinces.name: The Heartlands
provinces.description: The wealthy ring surrounding the royal center, offering rich farms and strategic keeps.

provinces.name: Royal Crownlands
provinces.description: The prestigious core of the kingdom, ruled by the sovereign occupying the Royal Keep.

gates.name: North Gate (Icewall)
gates.description: Chilled stone fortress guarding the northern entrance to the Heartlands. High strategic bottleneck.

gates.name: West Gate (Stonebridge)
gates.description: An immense fortified bridge arching over the Granite chasm, guarding the western entrance.

gates.name: East Gate (Dawnspire)
gates.description: Gilded gate reflecting the morning sun, defending the eastern approaches from the Sunplains.

gates.name: South Gate (Greenmarch)
gates.description: Overgrown vine-woven fortress standing fast against the creatures of the Verdant Wilds.

grand_landmarks.name: Hall of Champions
grand_landmarks.description: Ancient arena where legendary warriors carved their names. Grants martial supremacy to the occupying alliance.

grand_landmarks.name: Grand Forge
grand_landmarks.description: Fueled by volcanic fissures, this subterranean workshop pumps out elite armor and siege weaponry.

grand_landmarks.name: War Academy
grand_landmarks.description: The premier tactical library and training ground, training generations of strategic minds.

grand_landmarks.name: Temple of Dawn
grand_landmarks.description: High-altitude sanctuary capturing the first light. Radiates protective, restorative healing magic.

grand_landmarks.name: Merchant Guild
grand_landmarks.buffDescription: +15% Resource Gathering Speed, +10% Trade Tax Reduction
grand_landmarks.description: The central commercial exchange, coordinating regional trade caravans and resource allocation.

grand_landmarks.name: Thand Ar Earth
grand_landmarks.description: A colossal monolith carved directly into the living earth, reinforcing structural integrity and fortifications.

grand_landmarks.name: Royal Keep
grand_landmarks.buffDescription: Kingdom Ruler Designation, +15% All Stats for Alliance Leader
grand_landmarks.description: The ultimate throne of Crownspire Kingdom 001. Occupying this keep secures complete control of the realm.

royal_keep.name: Royal Keep
royal_keep.buffDescription: Kingdom Ruler Designation, +15% All Stats for Alliance Leader
royal_keep.description: The ultimate throne of Crownspire Kingdom 001. Occupying this keep secures complete control of the realm.

buildable_regions.name: Frostwood Clearance
buildable_regions.notes: Flat alpine clearings between pine lines. Rich windbreaks.

buildable_regions.name: Basalt Valley Plateaus
buildable_regions.notes: Terraced highland plateaus providing defensive choke points.

buildable_regions.name: Golden Breadbasket
buildable_regions.notes: Perfect open fields ideal for vast alliance bases and active farming.

buildable_regions.name: Verdant South Basin
buildable_regions.notes: Tropical marshland clearances with high water access.
